name: Serving One Another
overview: Scripture calls believers to serve one another with love and humility, reflecting Christ's example rather than worldly authority, as Jesus contrasts servant leadership with lordship (Mark 10:42). Christians are urged to bear each other's burdens (Galatians 6:2), serve through love (Galatians 5:13), and show kindness, forgiveness, and honor within the community (Romans 12:10; Ephesians 4:32). This mutual submission and tenderheartedness (Ephesians 5:21) fulfill the law of Christ and demonstrate the transformative power of the gospel in relationships among believers.
